newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares extend gains, activity picks up.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares extend gains, activity picks up.

text.p: Lithuanian shares continued to gain on Thursday as activity picked up on the country's bourse, dealers said.
Overall central market turnover in equities reached over 3.3 million litas and the group A index rose by 59.55 points to 2,543.54.
The group G index also advanced, edging up 75.13 points to 2,214.98.
Dealers said that domestic investors were returning to the market to take advantage of relatively low prices.
Birzai Dairy rose to 10.70 litas from 10.50 litas in trade of over 224,000 litas.
Lithuania Gas advanced five percent to 2.31 litas in turnover of 611,500 litas and Lithuania Energy jumped to 3.23 litas from 3.12 litas and over 307,000 litas worth of its shares changed hands.
Rokishkis Cheese shares were also in demand, turning over almost 270,000 litas at the price of 45.00 litas, up from 43.00 litas on Wednesday.
Rokishkis Cheese earlier announced that its 1996 net profit was 10.5 million litas versus 9.3 million litas the previous year.
"The Rokishkis results were broadly in line with what the market expected," Arvydas Jacikevicius of brokerage house Suprema told Reuters.
"And the fact that the shareholders failed to decide on a new issue of share capital means that there will be a bigger demand for its shares," he added.
In the banking sector, Hermis Bank gained, rising to 199.00 litas from 195.00 litas in trade of almost 250,000 litas.
Hermis Bank's 1996 results are expected to show a profit of around 25 million litas and its board will ask the shareholders to cover its 1995 loss with last year's profit.
Dealers say the final results will still be quite good.
Block trades worth over 5.3 million litas were also made at the session.
Low yields kept a lid on the secondary T-bill market, which recorded no transactions.
